description_en: Retrieves the script used to add existing ECS instances to an ACK cluster as worker nodes, or to re-add removed worker nodes to a node pool. ACK supports manually adding existing nodes to a node pool. You can invoke the DescribeClusterAttachScripts operation to obtain the script for adding existing nodes
description_zh: 如果需要将已有ECS实例添加到ACK集群中作为Worker节点，或移除Worker节点后需将节点实例重新加入节点池，ACK支持手动将已有节点到节点池。您可以调用DescribeClusterAttachScripts接口获取添加已有节点的脚本
name: DescribeClusterAttachScripts

parameters.help_en:
The CPU architecture of the node. Valid values: `amd64`, `arm`, and `arm64`.

Default value: `amd64`.

This parameter is required when the cluster type is ACK Edge
parameters.help_zh:
节点CPU架构。支持的CPU架构包括`amd64`、`arm`、`arm64`。

默认值：`amd64`。

当集群类型为边缘托管版时必填
parameters.name: arch

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the generated token. The time is in the UNIX timestamp format. For example, 1739980800 indicates 2025-02-20 00:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 描述生成的 token 的过期时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，如示例的1739980800 表示 2025-02-20 00:00:00
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to mount a data cloud disk to the instance when manually adding an existing instance to the cluster, and store containers and images on the data cloud disk. Valid values:

`true`: Mounts a data cloud disk to the instance. The existing data on the data cloud disk will be lost. Back up your data first.
`false`: Does not mount a data cloud disk to the instance.

Default value: `false`.

Data mounting rules:

If the ECS instance has a data cloud disk mounted and the file system of the last data cloud disk is not initialized, the system automatically formats the data cloud disk to ext4 to store the /var/lib/docker and /var/lib/kubelet directories.
If the ECS instance does not have a data cloud disk mounted, no new data cloud disk is mounted
parameters.help_zh:
手动添加已有实例到集群时，是否对该实例进行数据盘挂载，将容器和镜像存储在数据盘上。取值：

`true`：对实例进行数据盘挂载，数据盘内原有数据将丢失，请注意备份数据。
`false`：不对实例进行数据盘挂载。

默认值：`false`。

数据挂载规则：

如果 ECS 已挂载数据盘，且最后一块数据盘的文件系统未初始化，系统会自动将该数据盘格式化为 ext4，用来存放内容/var/lib/docker、/var/lib/kubelet 。
如果 ECS 未挂载数据盘，则不会挂载新的数据盘
parameters.name: format_disk

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the instance name when adding an existing instance to the cluster. If you do not retain the instance name, the instance name format is `worker-k8s-for-cs-<clusterid>`. Valid values:

`true`: Retains the instance name.
`false`: Does not retain the instance name. The instance name is replaced based on system rules.

Default value: `true`
parameters.help_zh:
添加已有实例到集群时，是否保留实例名称。如果不保留，则实例名称格式为`worker-k8s-for-cs-<clusterid>`。取值：

`true`：保留实例名称。
`false`：不保留实例名称，会用系统规则进行替换。

默认值：`true`
parameters.name: keep_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The node pool ID. You can add the node to a specified node pool when adding nodes.

If you do not specify a node pool ID, the node is added to the default node pool
parameters.help_zh:
节点池ID，添加节点时可以将该节点添加到指定的节点池中。

如果不指定节点池ID，默认将节点添加至默认节点池
parameters.name: nodepool_id

parameters.help_en:
The access configuration parameters for the node.

This parameter is required when the cluster type is ACK Edge
parameters.help_zh:
节点的接入配置参数。

当集群类型为边缘托管版时必填
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: If an ApsaraDB RDS instance list is specified, the ECS instances of the cluster nodes are automatically added to the RDS access whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 如果指定了RDS实例列表，集群节点ECS会自动加入RDS访问白名单
parameters.name: rds_instances
